title: Zesty German Haricot Bean Stew
description: A spicy and springy German stew featuring haricot beans, this dish is perfect for a solo dinner, and it is paleo-friendly, served in a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Rinse the haricot beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the beans, then place them in a large pot with the chicken broth.
Bring the broth to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery to the pot.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer the stew for 45 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Use a fork to mash some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the stew.
Serve the stew hot in a tagliere vessel.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
